final: WITH j AS (SELECT u.acctscope AS scope, f.feerate - f.rebrate AS net FROM fees f JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault JOIN users u ON o.userlink = u.userstamp), s AS (SELECT scope, AVG(net) AS avg_net, COUNT(*) AS fee_records FROM j GROUP BY scope) SELECT scope, avg_net, fee_records, avg_net - (SELECT AVG(avg_net) FROM s) AS diff_from_avg_of_avgs FROM s
